items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Steve Lewis used to get him out of jail and they played Victors. You did? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: I don't know if he was a piano player he might have been a singer entertainer gambler or something else. Yeah I understand. Did you ever heard of him then?
He played Victors Bill. Steve Lewis used to get him out of jail and they played Victors. You did?
